control_definitions.C0_STRUCTURAL: frozen baseline_vote_share for the same anonymous 92x9 panel stored in the private orchestrator manifest
control_definitions.AS1_PRIOR_ONLY: previous-election conditional party shares supplied in the common territory card; no LLM transition
control_definitions.AS2_LLM_INDEPENDENT: weighted aggregate of the opaque condition privately mapped to true political context
control_definitions.AS2_SHUFFLED_CONTEXT: weighted aggregate of the opaque condition privately mapped to density-matched deranged political context

primary_metric.name: macro_party_share_RMSE
primary_metric.panel: 92 territories x fixed 9 anonymous parties = 828 equally weighted cells per year

secondary_metrics.top_party_accuracy: fraction of territories where argmax predicted share equals argmax observed share; deterministic ties resolved lexicographically by anonymous party ID
secondary_metrics.turnout_MAE: mean over territories of abs(predicted turnout - observed turnout) when a canonical comparable turnout denominator exists for both control and treatment; otherwise report NOT_SCORABLE without changing the primary gate
secondary_metrics.local_seat_national_MAE: diagnostic only where a frozen historical legal allocator and compatible seat magnitude are available; NOT required for the historical sanity terminal gate
secondary_metrics.mean_energy_score: diagnostic only if the preregistered 20,000 ballot simulation is executed; NOT required for the historical sanity terminal gate

paired_bootstrap_diagnostic.probability_treatment_better: fraction of bootstrap replicates with RMSE_treatment < RMSE_control
paired_bootstrap_diagnostic.role: diagnostic for historical benchmarks; does not replace the frozen point-estimate historical sanity gates

contract_validity.numerator: schema-valid output rows whose packet/archetype IDs and party simplex exactly match the sealed handoff contract
contract_validity.reason: The protocol threshold is >=0.99, but the sealed Opus handoff itself requires all 47,104 rows before returning its PASS terminal status. No partial output is promoted to a passing terminal experiment.

historical_sanity_gates_exact.gate_1_contract: contract_validity_rate >= 0.99 AND sealed Opus terminal status is PASS_ASV2_HISTORICAL_VOTES_FROZEN_READY_FOR_SCORING
historical_sanity_gates_exact.gate_4_positive_signal: relative_improvement_AS2_TRUE_vs_C0 >= 0.01 in at least one of 2016 or 2021, where relative_improvement=(RMSE_C0-RMSE_AS2_TRUE)/RMSE_C0

interpretation_constraints: 2016 and 2021 are retrospective benchmarks and cannot establish pristine prospective alpha.
The severe 2016 context-discrimination warning must be printed in every scoring report: formal context density passed but zero districts had at least two cross-party discriminative context families.
AS2 beating AS1 is interesting but is not a frozen promotion gate; C0 and shuffled-context comparisons determine the historical sanity terminal state.
No prompt, model, archetype population, context shuffle, aggregation formula, metric, threshold or condition mapping may be changed after real ASV2 LLM outputs are inspected.
next_action_after_pass: Freeze a separate prospective 2026 Agent Society population, context snapshot, prompt/model hash, outputs and forecast before election day. F0 remains official.
next_action_after_fail: Stop ASV2 before 2026; do not run AS3 networked arm and do not tune on 2016/2021 outcomes.
